children.value: > Fact From Story: The EU AI Act itself likely won’t be in full force until some time in 2026 — given the final text must, once compiled (and translated into Member States’ languages), be affirmed by final votes in the parliament and Council, after which there’s a short period before the text of the law is published in the EU’s Official Journal and another before it comes into force.
> > Fact From Story: EU lawmakers have also agreed a phased approach to the Act’s compliance demands, with 24 months allowed before the high risk rules will apply for GPAIs. | Deduced Fact
> > Commonsense Knowledge: It takes time to fully implement a law, including establishing compliance demands. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: Laws cannot be implemented until they are affirmed by final votes and published.
